So my players are in the first stages of exploring a megadungeon, which is awesome. However, they have access to Leomund's Tiny Hut, which makes it relatively easy to have "safe" rests inside of the place. I want to make it less of a sure thing.

Since Leomund's makes a dome, I can always come up from underneath them. Purple worm, anyone? I can also use things like phase spiders or demons/devils which can plane hop to get inside.

How would you other DMs go about it? Players, what things would you worry about getting you if you were inside one?
Help me think of clever ways to get at PCs inside of a Leomund's Tiny Hut!

Have something create an illusion of great disaster outside of the hut, so that they are trapped in it for all 8 of those hours. Could be something along the lines of being submerged in an acid pool, or surrounded by demonic flames, or surrounded by thousands of starving monsters, constantly attacking the hut. Have the players roll to save against fear to add to the effect. Failure to save means they're frightened for the round.

Have a Darkness spell surround the dome at night (need a perception check to be aware of it). Bad guys surround the dome while the darkness gives them cover to lay traps as they just wait. The players wake up the next morning, never knowing that they're surrounded by danger until it's too late. If Darkness is too high level, Fog Cloud can work, too.

The wizard creating the hut was cursed at some point prior, causing his spells to behave in abhorrent ways. His LTH spell now creates a mimic that acts like the normal hut for 10 minutes, at which point, it gets smaller and nobody can escape. Attacking it with enough damage will cause a small and temporary rip that will eject the person causing damage. If it gets too small it will begin crushing people inside, causing damage and forcing disadvantage on everything they do.

And scrolls of Dispel Magic are always a thing. LTH is a level 3 spell, so there's no chance to save.

Contingency with....well....anything. A crafty evil doer could set up a Circle of Death with Contingency. Or a Teleportation Circle. Or Wall of Thorns.
